question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**trained**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the passage indicates that the subject has spent years developing a specific skill set.
 
• “**Trained**” is the most appropriate choice as it implies dedication and effort in learning to do one thing well.
 
• Other options like “**mesmerised**,” “**penalised**,” and “**abstained**” do not fit the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage:* He looks out of the window at the (1)* *falling__* *snow, then turns and takes his wife in his arms, feeling grateful to be here even as he wonders what he is going to do with his life in strictly practical terms. For years, he had (2)* *__trained__** himself to do one thing, and he did it well, but he doesn't know whether he wants to keep doing it for the rest of his life, for that matter, whether anyone will let him. He is still worrying when they go to bed.*

*They've been learning to get by with less, and they'll keep learning. It seems to him as if they're taking a course in loss lately. And as he feels himself falling asleep he has an (3) insight he believes is important, which he hopes he will remember in the morning, although it is one of those thoughts that seldom (4) survives translation to the language of daylight hours.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• “**Trained**” (प्रशिक्षित) : Correct as it fits the context of dedicating oneself to learning a skill.
 
• “**Mesmerised**” (मंत्रमुग्ध): Incorrect as it means to be captivated and does not fit the context.
 
• “**Penalised**” (दंडित): Incorrect as it means to be punished and does not fit the context.
 
• “**Abstained**” (परहेज): Incorrect as it means to deliberately avoid something and does not fit the context.
